Native6600ring, historical6800nominal eave, HAD7100eave and MAT7418.423wall line are distinct assembly datums. Arithmetic translation does not join roof structure, attic, weather skin, pitch, support, access or water receivers; complete weather height is withheld.

Exact ground slab construction is inherited only as an unselected ground case. Enclosure/air/gas/thermal/water returns, cold wet-leaf separation, anchors/bar continuity and site grade need actual joined construction.

WalkingFFL does not occlude piers. Exposed grade-to-FFL envelope680mm under no-occlusion comparison; actual facade/plinth closures, openings, pressure law and member tributaries must define raised wind.

Common actual wet beam soffit3020 translates to3550; local unfinished structural clearance3020. Cold post bases stay fixed, extending both known sections by530. The extension envelopes and density arithmetic are unadopted; actual cage/joints, mass, stiffness, loads and52-head response must rebuild.
